thread:
Morgan (People Ops): Hey team — quick rollout note: we've updated the Employee Handbook section on discretionary PTO, clarified carryover caps, and added an explicit line about previously approved exceptions. Managers need to confirm they reviewed the changes and complete the short compliance micro-course by Fri 2026-04-09.
Lena (Compliance): Link to updated handbook: https://company.docs/handbook/v2#pto. I flagged a phrasing change in the 'Carryover' paragraph for EU contractors. Diego, can you validate local policy alignment?
Diego (HRBP): On it. I'll review the EU wording and post any suggested wording edits in the doc comment thread by EOD Tue.
Sam (Manager): How do managers register their acknowledgement? Is there a central tracker?
Morgan (People Ops): Yes — tracker + auto-ack connector: https://sheets.redwood/policy-acks. Steps for managers: open sheet -> set "Reviewed" = Yes + date -> complete micro-course (link below) which posts completion. If course doesn't sync, upload screenshot in the sheet.
Aisha (Recruiting): Heads-up for hiring: add a checklist item "Manager: handbook ack complete" to the offer and onboarding workflow so new managers are covered. I'll add it to the template today.
PolicyBot: Reminder: Compliance micro-course "Handbook Essentials" (25m) available at https://learn.redwood/handbook-essentials. Completion auto-logs to tracker.
Lena (Compliance): Audit note: we need manager-level completion at 100% for the quarter. If anyone anticipates issues meeting the deadline, escalate to People Ops ASAP.
Sam (Manager): If a manager is on leave during the window, do we have a grace process?
Morgan (People Ops): Yes — tag @Diego in the tracker comments for temporary exemptions. We won't penalize people on approved leave; just document it.
Diego (HRBP): Also: this change is not retroactive for PTO already booked under previous wording. Added a clarifying sentence to the handbook section.
Aisha (Recruiting): For interim managers (acting managers on short-term assignments), should they complete the course?
Morgan (People Ops): Short answer: yes. The course is quick and gives necessary guidance. If completion is impractical for very short assignments (<2 weeks), note that in the tracker and tag @Diego.
Sam (Manager): Could we get a one-slide summary for our weekly team leads sync? Would help drive compliance.
Morgan (People Ops): I can prepare a 1-slide brief with the key bullets and the tracker link. Posting in #management-resources by Wed.
Lena (Compliance): I created a simple QA doc for managers with the top 6 FAQs. I'll share the link in the tracker comments.
PolicyBot: Scheduled reminder: Managers without a "Reviewed" entry will get an automated DM Fri 2026-04-03 10:00 UTC and a follow-up weekly until complete.
Aisha (Recruiting): Noted — I've updated the offer checklist template. Also adding "ack complete" as a gating item before offer acceptance for manager roles.
Diego (HRBP): I'll run a pre-audit export on Mon 2026-04-13 and send the CSV to Compliance + People Ops. Command for admins: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://people-api/export?sheet=policy-acks" > policy_acks.csv
Sam (Manager): Thanks. One last ask: can we get a team-level report for director reviews?
Morgan (People Ops): Yes — DM me org name and I'll generate a per-team CSV.
Lena (Compliance): Final reminder: please complete course and update tracker by the deadline. We'll escalate late cases to the manager's People Partner.
Morgan (People Ops): Closing this thread — I'll post the slide and a short summary after the final audit. Thanks everyone.
